summary: The visible suite now passes (3/3). I changed only `solution/core.py`, and nothing under `tests/` or the public `format_table` signature. The cause was an off-by-one in the column-capacity arithmetic. A column's width `w` is the number of content characters it can hold (the border is `w + 2`), but `_cell_lines` wrapped at `w - 1` and `_align` padded to `w - len - 1`. That made cells wrap and pad one character too early, which produced the `| n | word |` misalignment in the exact example. A related bug in the same wrap loop emitted a full-width chunk and then an empty remainder line, which caused the extra blank row in `test_header_wider_than_data`. The fix changes the wrap condition to `len(line) > width` and the padding to `width - len(text)`. I did not add any other changes or run the hidden suite, so the remaining behavior is untested beyond the visible tests.
